title: Skydive the Mills

services.name: Tandem skydive
services.desc: Have you always wanted to skydive? Skydive the Mills on Cape Cod is the premier destination for first-time tandem skydivers in Massachusetts. Our USPA-certified instructors are seasoned professionals who will make sure your first skydive is safe, comfortable, and unforgettable. Jump from 10,000 feet over one of the most breathtaking views on the East Coast. Located at historic Cape Cod Airfield in Marstons Mills, we're just one hour from Boston and Providence and convenient to Plymouth, New Bedford, Hyannis, and all of Cape Cod. Bring the whole crew and make a day of it. Everyone, even non-jumpers, will love the airfield atmosphere. After your jump, hit the beach, grab some seafood, or
